findings.description: The doc comment on `explain` says 'Match.tagsExhaustive makes a fifteenth policy variant a compile error here' (implying 14 variants currently exist), but the `Match.tagsExhaustive` block that follows actually has 16 arms (HasPermission, HasRole, HasAttribute, HasResourceAttribute, HasRelationship, HasAction, HasActed, HasNotActed, HasCustom, HasSignature, AllOf, AnyOf, Not, Labeled, Obliged, Rules). A 17th variant, not a 15th, would be the next compile error. This is exactly the kind of stale exact-count claim AGENTS.md §5a/§15 call out as having bitten this repo before (e.g. 'two' vs 'four' switches).
findings.suggestedFix: Update the comment to state the correct current count (16) or drop the specific ordinal and just say 'a new policy variant is a compile error here'.

findings.description: The doc block at lines 25-32 ('A term: what one leaf of a policy asks for... `detail` is the leaf's own words...') describes the `Requirement` interface's `detail` field, but it is placed directly above `RequirementKind` (line 34, which has its own separate doc comment immediately below it at line 33). The `Requirement` interface itself (line 44) has no leading doc comment at all. This reads as a comment left behind by a refactor that split what used to be one doc block, and it will not attach to `Requirement` in generated docs or IDE hovers.
findings.suggestedFix: Move the lines 25-32 comment down to sit directly above `export interface Requirement {` (line 44), where it actually describes the shape.

findings.description: `matcherText`'s `SomeMatch` arm renders "has an entry that <sub-clause>" but the `EveryMatch` arm renders "has every entry <sub-clause>" (missing "that"), producing the grammatically inconsistent sentence "has every entry is present" (pinned by Explanation.test.ts line 452) instead of "has every entry that is present". Purely cosmetic — the sentence is still shown to a human reviewer via `renderExplanation` — but the two sibling matchers should read consistently.
findings.suggestedFix: Change the `EveryMatch` template to `has every entry that ${matcherText(m.matcher)}` and update the pinned assertion in Explanation.test.ts (line 452) to match.
